messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: LB health checks failing in us-west-2 (edge-loadbalancer-prod)
incident-bot: Symptoms: increased TLS handshake failures and LB target flapping. 5xx spike ~13% over last 5m. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Alert ID: PD-89321
jay: acked on PagerDuty. I'm oncall for next 60m. starting triage.
maria: seeing same in metrics — TLS handshake error rate up, and backend target count dropping from 24 -> 6 in us-west-2.
dan: logs show repeated `ERR_SSL_HANDSHAKE` from edge proxies to backend. stack traces point to SNI mismatch at TLS layer.
alex: any recent cert rotations? I deployed a cert rotation job ~2h ago for internal-backend-usw2.
maria: cert rotation finished but CA chain was updated; some edge proxies might have stale cache.
jay: ok plan: 1) shift small traffic % away from us-west-2 to eu-west-1 (weight shift) 2) force health-check reconcilers to re-register targets 3) check certs on edge proxies and backends
jay: performing weight shift now — rolling 15% traffic to eu-west-1 via route config (will monitor RTT/5xx)
incident-bot: Routing config change submitted: route-weight update for us-west-2 -> 85% (was 100%). Change ID: RC-7745
maria: running `kubectl get pods -n infra edge-proxy-usw2 -o wide` shows a mix of versions, some still with old cert bundle.
dan: pulling handshake logs from edge-proxy-2:
```
2026-03-14T15:12:05Z edge-proxy-2 TLS ERR: handshake error: remote error: tls: internal error
2026-03-14T15:12:06Z connection to backend i-0a12.. closed during handshake
```
alex: cross-checking backend certs: cert for internal-backend-usw2.pem valid until 2026-09, but subjectAltName doesn't include `internal.edge.redwood` — that might explain SNI mismatch.
jay: oof. Did the rotation script accidentally swap SANs? @alex can you roll back to previous cert bundle while we keep weight shifted?
alex: rolling rollback now to cert-bundle v2026-03-13 (previous). Command:
```
opsctl certs apply --service internal-backend-usw2 --bundle v2026-03-13 --force
```
paul: paging in from networking: DNS TTL for edge CNAMEs was reduced to 60s yesterday for testing, but some caches still have old records. might cause partial routing to old instances.
maria: that explains partial region effect. some clients hit new edge proxies with updated cert expectations, others still to old ones -> handshake mismatch
jay: alex, once cert rollback completes, restart health-checker on edge proxies to re-evaluate targets. dan, can you add temporary increase to health-check interval to reduce flapping noise?
dan: setting health-check retry window to 10s -> 30s, updating in config now.
incident-bot: Cert rollback job completed (alex). Health-check restart scheduled: HC-5567
alex: restarted edge-proxy pods gracefully one at a time, watch logs.
maria: within 3 mins handshake error rate dropped to 2.1% and backend target count back to 22.
jay: slowly move weight back to us-west-2 to 95% and monitor for 10m before full restore.
incident-bot: Route-weight update submitted: us-west-2 -> 95% (RC-7746)
paul: coordinated with CDN team — they purged a few caches that still pointed at old IPs. propagation should be within TTL (~60s) now.
alex: quick smoke: `curl -v https://edge.us-west-2.redwood.ai/v1/generate` shows TLS handshake success and 200 OK
maria: checking customer error dashboards — top customers affected: 3 mid-market tenants saw transient 502/503 spikes, all requests retried ok after ~30-90s.
jay: filing PD follow-up: severity de-escalate to S3. Will run post-incident review. I'll hand off final monitoring to paul; I'm available if it regresses.
paul: taking over monitoring now. will coordinate write-up with maria and alex. ETA for postmortem draft: 24h.
jay: thanks team. Summary for ops: root cause = cert bundle rotation that removed an expected SAN + DNS cache propagation causing mixed routing. Mitigations: rollback cert bundle, restart proxies, temporary route weight shift, CDN purge, increased health-check window.
alex: opened internal PR to tighten cert rotation checks and add SAN validation in rotation script.
dan: also added alert rule tweak to combine TLS handshake spikes with target-unhealthy to reduce noisy pages.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert resolved (PD-89321). If any residual errors, please post in this thread.
paul: marking thread for postmortem. tagging: @incident-review
jay: good job. :thumbsup:
